mentions.name: Protein 3D graph query tool
mentions.description: A graph query description and measurement tool for protein 3D data. Its query engine is structured as a DAG of operators (scanners, filters, and matchers), similar in style to a relational or graph database.
mentions.source_excerpt: It is a kind of graph query description/measurement tool for protein 3D data.
